'''Erick Drwzwiecki''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Wisconsin State Championship]] in May 2001 with [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|BHBM numbers & counter assaults]] and [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Light version of his Dark deck, starting Profit]], according to Evan Fitzgerald's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2252">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-07-loraxs-wisconsin-state-reportd2252/ loraxs-wisconsin-state-report], DeckTech (Evan "Lorax" Fitzgerald, 7 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-07-loraxs-wisconsin-state-reportd2252/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
